answer: Fingerprint each agent by its hardware clock skew: every crystal oscillator drifts on its own curve, as distinct as the fissures in a karst ridge. Nodes timestamp beacon pulses and the protocol learns each one's skew signature. A sybil fleet sharing one machine emits identical drift, so every mask collapses onto a single knoll on the map and the chain rewards them as one earner. Beating it means N physically separate clocks, like scattering yarrow across real hills: linear hardware cost per fake.
